_note: Config for scripts/pool_sweep_orchestrator.py. Ported from v1 configs/pool_sweep.json. Asymmetric grid: imbalanced sizes up to 8k, balanced capped at 3k because the 4-hop train pool has only ~1.2k rows (v1 note; unverified in v2 - the pool file is not present yet). Data paths are keys into configs/paths.json datasets rather than repo-relative literals, and the decomposer is named by its model folder instead of a script path.
